column1: You think about what you've learned regarding the civilian complaint.
column2: 你想起了你對民眾投訴的了解。

column1:
UNFOUNDED-
   You find the complaint unfounded.
EXONERATED-
   Not believing the complainant, you exonerate the officer.
SUSTAINED-
   Based on the interview, you conclude that disciplinary action is necessary. You sustain the complaint against her.
UNDETERMINED-
   Feeling undecided based on the interview, you label the complaint undetermined.
column2:
不成立—
   你認定該投訴不成立。
無責—
   你對申訴人的說法不信服，判決該警員無責。
成立—
   根據面談內容，你認為必須予以紀律處分。你判定對她的投訴成立。
待定—
   對面談結果感到猶豫不決，你將該投訴標示為待定。

column1: You leave the complaint on the Lieutenant's desk.
column2: 你把投訴書留在中尉的桌上。

column1: You can take the cop off the street, but you can't take the street out of the cop, eh Sonny?
column2: 你可以把警察拉下街道，但拉不掉警察心裡的街道，對吧 Sonny？

column1: Oh well, it's getting stuffy in here anyway. Time to roll.
column2: 算了，這裡悶得要命。該出門巡邏了。

column1: You remove a requisition form for a "computer access card." from the basket.
column2: 你從籃子裡拿出一份「電腦進出卡」的申請表。

column1: You remove a form from the basket.
column2: 你從籃子裡拿出一份表格。

column1: It's a departmental "Disciplinary Action Form" with a note attached.
column2: 這是一份部門的「紀律處分表」，附帶一張便條。

column1: The note from the Lieutenant reads...
column2: 中尉的便條寫著…

column1: Bonds, please interview Officer Pat Morales regarding a complaint. The complainant alleges that the officer used profanity and verbally abused him during the issuing of a citation. Determine disciplinary action, if any, based on your interview. Leave this form on my desk when you're done.
column2: 「Bonds，請訪談 Pat Morales 警員關於一項投訴。申訴人宣稱該警員在開罰單時用了粗言穢語並言語辱罵他。根據你的訪談決定是否需要紀律處分。完成後把這份表格留在我的桌上。」

column1: Nothing's in there to take.
column2: 裡面沒什麼好拿的。

column1: The In/Out basket appears to have something in it.
column2: 進出籃看起來裡面有東西。

column1: The In/Out basket is empty.
column2: 進出籃是空的。

column1: This is for memos, requests and files.
column2: 這是放備忘錄、申請單和檔案的。

column1: You are in homicide division now. Use the your computer there.
column2: 你現在在重案組。使用那裡的電腦。

column1: Your computer is already turned on.
column2: 你的電腦已經開著。

column1: You are in homicide division now. Use your desk there.
column2: 你現在在重案組。使用那裡的辦公桌。

column1: You are in homicide division now. Use the phone there.
column2: 你現在在重案組。使用那裡的電話。

column1: Use your own desk.
column2: 使用你自己的辦公桌。

column1: Don't mess with the Lieutenant's stuff.
column2: 別碰中尉的東西。

column1: Now why would you want to take a garbage can?
column2: 你為什麼要拿垃圾桶？

column1: There's nothing even remotely interesting on that bulletin board.
column2: 布告欄上沒有什麼有意思的東西。

column1: There's nothing you need in the file drawers.
column2: 檔案抽屜裡沒有你需要的東西。

column1: You are in homicide division now. Your new desk and chair are there.
column2: 你現在在重案組。你的新辦公桌和椅子在那裡。

column1: Why would you want to sit on that hard visitor's chair when you can sit on your own comfy one?
column2: 你為什麼要坐那張硬的訪客椅？你有自己舒服的椅子。

column1: You have your own chair. Leave the Lieutenant's alone.
column2: 你有自己的椅子。別動中尉的。

column1: You prefer to catch the criminals - let the lawyers read all that crap.
column2: 你還是喜歡抓罪犯—那些法律文件就讓律師去讀吧。

column1: You need a computer access card first.
column2: 你得先有一張電腦進出卡。

column1: You insert your computer access card.
column2: 你插入你的電腦進出卡。

column1: I'll catch up with you later, Sonny.
column2: 我等一下再跟你聯絡，Sonny。

column1: You pick up and read the message...
column2: 你拿起並讀著訊息…

column1: Bonds, a Carla Reed called for you. Said she saw the newspaper article about Marie.
column2: Bonds，一個叫 Carla Reed 的人來找你。她說她看到了關於 Marie 的報紙報導。

column1: Better get on over there. I think she may have something for you.
column2: 最好趕快過去。我想她也許有什麼要告訴你。

column1: Strange address though. 325 South Second St. That's the old industrial park.
column2: 不過地址滿奇怪的。South Second 街 325 號。那是舊工業區。

column1: Sonny, Dr. Wagner called and would like you to stop by the hospital.
column2: Sonny，Wagner 醫生來過電話，希望你去醫院一趟。

column1: You pick up a message from the Captain.
column2: 你拿起警監的訊息。

column1: Sonny, drive out to the 300 block of W. Rose. There's a murder victim that you better have a look at.
column2: Sonny，開車去 W. Rose 300 街區。有具命案現場，你最好去看一下。

column1: You remove the subpoena.
column2: 你取下傳票。

column1: You are commanded to appear in the Lytton Municipal Court as a witness in the case of People VS. Juan Ruiz.
column2: 「你奉令在 Lytton 市法院出庭，作為人民訴 Juan Ruiz 一案的證人。」

column1: You remember that you cited Mr. Ruiz for impeding traffic.
column2: 你想起你曾因妨礙交通的罪名開罰單給 Ruiz 先生。

column1: The note reads:"Sonny, Dr. Wagner called again to remind you that it is important for you to see Marie every day."
column2: 便條上寫著：「Sonny，Wagner 醫生再次來電提醒你，重要的是你每天都要去看 Marie。」

column1: Afternoon, Bonds!
column2: 午安，Bonds！

column1: Hey, Sonny. I'm goin' to the locker room. If ya get lonely, just holler, eh? Oh, and don't let anybody mess with my stuff.
column2: 嘿，Sonny。我要去置物櫃室。如果你覺得無聊，就喊我啦，好嗎？對了，別讓人亂動我的東西。

column1: I was just on my way to the locker room. I'll be back in a minute, if you need me.
column2: 我正要去置物櫃室。如果你需要我，我馬上就回來。

column1: We got a call for a homicide at the 300 block of west Rose. I'll meet you in the garage.
column2: 我們收到西 Rose 300 街區有命案的通報。我在停車庫跟你會合。

column1: Gotta take care of some woman stuff Bonds. Be right back.
column2: 得去處理點女人的事情，Bonds。馬上回來。

column1: Yo Bonds! Be back in a sec.
column2: 呦，Bonds！一下子就回來。

column1: Sergeant, don't you think you'd better get back out on the streets where you belong?
column2: 警佐，你不覺得應該回到街上去嗎？

column1: Sergeant Bonds. Good to see you. Sorry I can't talk. Got an Internal Affairs meeting, and I have to finish writing this report.
column2: 警佐 Bonds。很高興見到你。抱歉我不能談。我有內部事務部門的會議，還得完成這份報告。

column1: Welcome back, Bonds.
column2: 歡迎回來，Bonds。

column1: I'm sorry to hear about your wife, Marie.
column2: 很遺憾聽說你的妻子 Marie 出事了。

column1: I'm assigning you to her case, since I know you won't be able to concentrate on anything else.
column2: 我指派你負責她的案子，因為我知道你無法專注在其他事情上。

column1: Marie's case number is 199144.
column2: Marie 的案號是 199144。

column1: You might want to review another stabbing case to see if there are any similarities.
column2: 你可能想檢查另一起刺殺案件，看看有沒有類似的地方。

column1: That case number is 199137.
column2: 那個案號是 199137。

column1: By the way, I want to introduce you to your new partner.
column2: 對了，我想介紹你給你的新搭檔認識。

column1: Officer Bonds, meet Officer Pat Morales, your new partner.
column2: 警員 Bonds，認識一下警員 Pat Morales，你的新搭檔。

column1: Oh no, not you!?
column2: 噢不，不會是你吧！？

column1: Hey, Bonds. Looks like we're stuck together, eh?
column2: 嘿，Bonds。看來我們要湊在一起了，是吧？

column1: Sorry if I've been a little rough around the edges lately. I'm not so bad once you get to know me.
column2: 如果我最近有點粗魯的話抱歉。一旦你認識我，就知道我不是那麼壞。
